text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Hmm. Hmmm... The winning team from 
this year clearly has a whole different 
level of sensibility...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's watch the next year's 
"Manzai Stakes" too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That'll make 32 years' worth in a row, you 
know?! Pearl-san, you really ought to rest 
your eyes soon...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—And aren't you reading manga yourself? 
That 4-panel comic loved by kids and 
adults alike. Which volume was the 
funniest?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Volume 97, I'd say~. Though I still have 
58 volumes left to go.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmh...!! So many!! That is quite a lot, 
Fukukitaru...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Pearl-san! Fukukitaru-san!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Mayano! There's still a whole hour 
before our meet-up time, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Listen! Maya just came up with a 
great idea!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Let's decide on each of our roles in the 
band! For the sake of comedy too—we should 
make it super clear "how we want people to 
see us"!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Like, Maya could play the cool role! 
Sounds good, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—『Having serious members will make the 
comedy pop even more. Plus, the mismatch 
will make it way funnier, right?!』

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
『Don't worry, don't worry! We'll 
definitely become the kind of band you and 
the others envision, Pearl-san!』

text_block_list.name: Live House Owner
text_block_list.text: —Pfft!

text_block_list.name: Live House Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, sorry! Did I break your focus? 
Though... hehe. You guys have evolved into 
even more of a wacky band~."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Look! See, see?! ――Pearl-san!!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"――...Yes, that's it! 
That's a wonderful idea to bring smiles to 
everyone's faces!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"A fusion of funny and cool! 
Our band is getting edgier and more unique 
by the second!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Yes... and what we're aiming for is 
happiness, right?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Then first, we have to be happy 
ourselves."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Yup, yup! Gotta keep an open mind! 
And with this, Maya can also play some 
cool bass――"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"――Wait... 
This sound and rhythm is――"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "I knew it! Brian-san!!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Are you ignoring me~?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"! Geez, answering with your instrument 
again! 
...Though your muting technique is already 
looking good♪"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"How's your band doing, Brian-san? 
Is practice going well?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Decent enough, I suppose... Though you 
look like you're doing pretty well 
yourself."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Yup! I was overthinking things before, 
but I found a way for everyone to achieve 
their goals!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Pearl-san and the others can do funny 
stuff! Maya can do cool stuff! 
We just had to split our roles!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, why did you start a 
band, Brian-san?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"It's not like you had experience 
beforehand, 
and I always thought you weren't the type 
to get into stuff like this."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "I was half-dragged into it."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...However, for the other half, I thought 
what Ama-san said 
wasn't entirely nonsense, either."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pluuum...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as I thought, go ask someone 
else."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Now, now, no one can play right away just 
by touching it. 
Don't jump to conclusions so fast."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, there's another group practicing 
besides us. 
Why don't we go take a little peek?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Brian, let me introduce you. 
This is Pearl-senpai and Fukukitaru's 
band."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Hishiama. 
Did you finally decide to join our band 
after all?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry, but no. I've already made up my 
mind 
to do things my own way."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"More importantly, there's something I 
want to show Brian today, 
and I'd love it if you could lend a hand. 
Is that alright?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "――...Hah! And... finish!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "...Ama-san, you're good."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Heheh, thanks! But it's not my skills I 
wanted to show you. 
Alright, Pearl-senpai, you're up!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, let's do this, Fukukitaru! 
*Inhale*――...!"

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Hokke! Hokke! Hokke! Hokke! 
Yaa-ren! Green veggies! Bok choy!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "...What... is this song?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha! Well, I can't blame you for 
thinking that. 
After all, they don't cheer people on 
head-on like we do."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...But look at them as a fellow band with 
the same ambition. 
Or better yet, how does it look from the 
perspective of someone receiving that 
cheer?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly. Their sweat carries immense 
power. It swallows up everyone in the 
room."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"But since I want to convey the heat of 
racing, 
I can't afford to be swallowed by my band 
rivals either."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"A live show is also a showdown against 
the other bands. 
Brian, won't you tear up the stage with 
me?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"――A band has nothing to do with my races. 
Nor do I have any interest in cheering on 
other Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...However, with Ama-san being dead 
serious, and her opponents being dead 
serious, 
I'm not so dull as to feel nothing in 
front of that."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"To face a serious opponent and genuinely 
devour them... 
That is why I am in a band."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Eh? So Brian-san, the reason you're in 
a band 
is to compete with Pearl-san and the 
others?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"B-But your genres are totally different! 
Even in racing, you can't 
compete together if your distances are 
different, right?! Pearl-san's band is――"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...What's this? 
Weren't you the Umamusume who 
'understands' everything?"
